scenes.say: Americano and loon-go are not the same coffee.
They look alike. But the water takes different routes.
Loon-go means long. Extra water runs through the grounds. An americano gets hot water afterward.
Flavors dissolve at different rates. More water through the coffee changes the taste.

scenes.title: At home.
scenes.say: Pull your usual shot. Add hot water after.
Same look, different route. Send this to an americano drinker.
